instruction.text: Read and listen to the story, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: The tiger caught the mouse deer once more. The mouse deer thought fast and looked around her. “Wait! You can’t eat me! I am guarding the king’s drum,” said the mouse deer, pointing at a wasp’s nest.
atoms.sound: ssml: The tiger caught the mouse deer once more. The mouse deer thought fast and looked around her.<voice voice='f2'> “Wait! You can’t eat me! I am guarding the king’s drum,” </voice>said the mouse deer, pointing at a wasp’s nest.

atoms.text: “The king’s drum!” thought the tiger. “I would love to beat on the same drum as the king. I deserve to bang on that drum.” The tiger let the mouse deer go and hit the ‘drum'. Wasps flew out of the nest and began stinging the tiger painfully.

atoms.a: What did the tiger think the wasp’s nest was?
Why did the tiger let the mouse deer go for a second time?
b: so he could brush his teeth
++so he could bang on the drum

instruction.text: Read and listen to the story, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: “You tricked me a second time! Now you will not escape me,” said the tiger angrily, and he caught the mouse deer once again.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m3'>“You tricked me a second time! Now you will not escape me,”</voice> said the tiger angrily, and he caught the mouse deer once again.<break time='600ms'/>

atoms.text: Now the mouse deer was getting nervous. She thought fast and looked around her. “Wait! You can’t eat me. The king asked me to guard his belt,” said the mouse deer, pointing at a sleeping cobra.

instruction.text: Read and listen to the story, then answer the questions.

atoms.text: “The king’s belt!” thought the tiger. He imagined how beautiful the belt would look on him instead of the king. “I should wear that belt,” thought the tiger arrogantly.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voice='m3'>“The king’s belt!”</voice> thought the tiger. He imagined how beautiful the belt would look on him instead of the king. <voice voice='m3'>“I should wear that belt,”</voice> thought the tiger arrogantly.

atoms.text: The tiger began to put the belt on, when too late, he realised it was a snake! The mouse deer escaped again and did not have to trick the tiger a fourth time.
atoms.sound: ssml: The tiger began to put the belt on, when too late, he realized it was a snake! The mouse deer escaped again and did not have to trick the tiger a fourth time.

atoms.a: Was the mouse deer able to trick the tiger a third time?
What do you think the word arrogantly means?
b: ++to act in a way where someone thinks they are more important than others
to laugh at the wrong time

atoms.a: What do you think the lesson or moral of this story is?
b: always say please and thank you
